concept.concept_description: Conjecture: Let A be a line arrangement in the complex projective plane of degree d such that every singular point has multiplicity at most 3 (i.e., only double and triple points). If the minimal degree of a Jacobian relation satisfies mdr(A) < d/2, then mdr(A) is combinatorially determined: any other line arrangement B with the same intersection lattice (and hence the same singularity multiplicities) has mdr(B) = mdr(A).

Apply Saito's criterion for freeness and the relation between the exponents of the arrangement and the degrees of minimal syzygies. Show that under the hypothesis mdr < d/2 the arrangement is plus-one generated, which forces the Jacobian syzygy module to have a predictable graded structure determined solely by the intersection lattice. Verify the claim by computing the relevant graded Betti numbers via Gröbner basis techniques in the polynomial ring S = C[x,y,z].

namespace CartesianProductDomination

open SimpleGraph

variable {V W : Type*}

/-! ## Domination number of a finite graph -/

/-- `D` is a dominating set of `G`: every vertex is in `D` or adjacent to a member of `D`. -/
def IsDominatingSet (G : SimpleGraph V) (D : Finset V) : Prop :=
  ∀ v, v ∈ D ∨ ∃ d ∈ D, G.Adj d v

/-- The domination number of a finite graph: the least size of a dominating set. -/
noncomputable def dominationNumber [Fintype V] (G : SimpleGraph V) : ℕ :=
  sInf {k | ∃ D : Finset V, IsDominatingSet G D ∧ D.card = k}

/-- The full vertex set is always dominating. -/
theorem univ_isDominating [Fintype V] (G : SimpleGraph V) :
    IsDominatingSet G Finset.univ := fun v => Or.inl (Finset.mem_univ v)

/-- The domination number is a lower bound witnessed by any dominating set. -/
theorem dominationNumber_le_of_isDominating [Fintype V] {G : SimpleGraph V}
    {D : Finset V} (h : IsDominatingSet G D) : dominationNumber G ≤ D.card :=
  Nat.sInf_le ⟨D, h, rfl⟩

/-- A minimum dominating set is attained (the defining set is nonempty since `univ` works). -/
theorem exists_min_dominating [Fintype V] (G : SimpleGraph V) :
    ∃ D : Finset V, IsDominatingSet G D ∧ D.card = dominationNumber G := by
  have hne : {k | ∃ D : Finset V, IsDominatingSet G D ∧ D.card = k}.Nonempty :=
    ⟨Finset.univ.card, Finset.univ, univ_isDominating G, rfl⟩
  exact Nat.sInf_mem hne

/-! ## Projection lower bounds for the box product -/

/-- **Projection of a product-dominating set dominates the first factor.**
If `D` dominates `G □ H`, then its image under `Prod.fst` dominates `G`.  This is the key
structural fact behind the lower bound `γ(G) ≤ γ(G □ H)`. -/
theorem image_fst_isDominating [DecidableEq V] [Nonempty W]
    {G : SimpleGraph V} {H : SimpleGraph W} {D : Finset (V × W)}
    (h : IsDominatingSet (G □ H) D) : IsDominatingSet G (D.image Prod.fst) := by
  intro v
  have w : W := Classical.arbitrary W
  rcases h (v, w) with hin | ⟨d, hd, hadj⟩
  · left; exact Finset.mem_image_of_mem _ hin
  · rw [boxProd_adj] at hadj
    rcases hadj with ⟨hg, _⟩ | ⟨_, he⟩
    · right; exact ⟨d.1, Finset.mem_image_of_mem _ hd, hg⟩
    · left
      have hdv : d.1 = v := he
      rw [← hdv]; exact Finset.mem_image_of_mem _ hd

/-- **Projection of a product-dominating set dominates the second factor.** -/
theorem image_snd_isDominating [DecidableEq W] [Nonempty V]
    {G : SimpleGraph V} {H : SimpleGraph W} {D : Finset (V × W)}
    (h : IsDominatingSet (G □ H) D) : IsDominatingSet H (D.image Prod.snd) := by
  intro w
  have v : V := Classical.arbitrary V
  rcases h (v, w) with hin | ⟨d, hd, hadj⟩
  · left; exact Finset.mem_image_of_mem _ hin
  · rw [boxProd_adj] at hadj
    rcases hadj with ⟨_, he⟩ | ⟨hh, _⟩
    · left
      have hdw : d.2 = w := he
      rw [← hdw]; exact Finset.mem_image_of_mem _ hd
    · right; exact ⟨d.2, Finset.mem_image_of_mem _ hd, hh⟩

/-- **Lower bound (first factor):** `γ(G) ≤ γ(G □ H)`. -/
theorem dominationNumber_le_boxProd_left [Fintype V] [Fintype W] [Nonempty W]
    {G : SimpleGraph V} {H : SimpleGraph W} :
    dominationNumber G ≤ dominationNumber (G □ H) := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨D, hD, hcard⟩ := exists_min_dominating (G □ H)
  calc dominationNumber G ≤ (D.image Prod.fst).card :=
        dominationNumber_le_of_isDominating (image_fst_isDominating hD)
    _ ≤ D.card := Finset.card_image_le
    _ = dominationNumber (G □ H) := hcard

/-- **Lower bound (second factor):** `γ(H) ≤ γ(G □ H)`. -/
theorem dominationNumber_le_boxProd_right [Fintype V] [Fintype W] [Nonempty V]
    {G : SimpleGraph V} {H : SimpleGraph W} :
    dominationNumber H ≤ dominationNumber (G □ H) := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨D, hD, hcard⟩ := exists_min_dominating (G □ H)
  calc dominationNumber H ≤ (D.image Prod.snd).card :=
        dominationNumber_le_of_isDominating (image_snd_isDominating hD)
    _ ≤ D.card := Finset.card_image_le
    _ = dominationNumber (G □ H) := hcard

/-- **Combined lower bound:** `max (γ G) (γ H) ≤ γ (G □ H)`. -/
theorem boxProd_dominationNumber_ge_max [Fintype V] [Fintype W] [Nonempty V] [Nonempty W]
    {G : SimpleGraph V} {H : SimpleGraph W} :
    max (dominationNumber G) (dominationNumber H) ≤ dominationNumber (G □ H) :=
  max_le dominationNumber_le_boxProd_left dominationNumber_le_boxProd_right

/-! ## Product upper bounds for the box product -/

/-- **Upper bound (first factor):** `γ(G □ H) ≤ γ(G) · |V(H)|`.
Blowing a minimum dominating set of `G` across all of `V(H)` dominates the product. -/
theorem boxProd_dominationNumber_le_left [Fintype V] [Fintype W]
    {G : SimpleGraph V} {H : SimpleGraph W} :
    dominationNumber (G □ H) ≤ dominationNumber G * Fintype.card W := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨DG, hDG, hcard⟩ := exists_min_dominating G
  have hdom : IsDominatingSet (G □ H) (DG ×ˢ Finset.univ) := by
    rintro ⟨v, w⟩
    rcases hDG v with hin | ⟨d, hd, hadj⟩
    · left; exact Finset.mem_product.2 ⟨hin, Finset.mem_univ _⟩
    · right; refine ⟨(d, w), Finset.mem_product.2 ⟨hd, Finset.mem_univ _⟩, ?_⟩
      rw [boxProd_adj]; left; exact ⟨hadj, rfl⟩
  have h1 := dominationNumber_le_of_isDominating hdom
  rw [Finset.card_product, hcard, Finset.card_univ] at h1
  exact h1

/-- **Upper bound (second factor):** `γ(G □ H) ≤ γ(H) · |V(G)|`. -/
theorem boxProd_dominationNumber_le_right [Fintype V] [Fintype W]
    {G : SimpleGraph V} {H : SimpleGraph W} :
    dominationNumber (G □ H) ≤ dominationNumber H * Fintype.card V := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨DH, hDH, hcard⟩ := exists_min_dominating H
  have hdom : IsDominatingSet (G □ H) (Finset.univ ×ˢ DH) := by
    rintro ⟨v, w⟩
    rcases hDH w with hin | ⟨d, hd, hadj⟩
    · left; exact Finset.mem_product.2 ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, hin⟩
    · right; refine ⟨(v, d), Finset.mem_product.2 ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, hd⟩, ?_⟩
      rw [boxProd_adj]; right; exact ⟨hadj, rfl⟩
  have h1 := dominationNumber_le_of_isDominating hdom
  rw [Finset.card_product, hcard, Finset.card_univ] at h1
  simpa [Nat.mul_comm] using h1

/-- **Combined upper bound:** `γ(G □ H) ≤ min (γ G · |H|) (γ H · |V|)`. -/
theorem boxProd_dominationNumber_le_min [Fintype V] [Fintype W]
    {G : SimpleGraph V} {H : SimpleGraph W} :
    dominationNumber (G □ H) ≤
      min (dominationNumber G * Fintype.card W) (dominationNumber H * Fintype.card V) :=
  le_min boxProd_dominationNumber_le_left boxProd_dominationNumber_le_right

/-! ## The improved constant `(19 - √73)/18` -/

/-- The improved Vizing-type constant. -/
noncomputable def improvedConstant : ℝ := (19 - Real.sqrt 73) / 18

/-- **The improved constant is a root of the optimizing quadratic** `9x² - 19x + 8 = 0`.
This is the algebraic origin of the value `(19 - √73)/18`. -/

    9 * improvedConstant ^ 2 - 19 * improvedConstant + 8 = 0 := by

  nlinarith [hs]

  unfold improvedConstant

      apply Real.sqrt_lt_sqrt <;> norm_num
    simpa [show (81 : ℝ) = 9 ^ 2 by norm_num, Real.sqrt_sq] using this
  linarith

/-- **The improved constant is below `1`** (so it is a genuine fraction of `γ(G)γ(H)`). -/
theorem improvedConstant_lt_one : improvedConstant < 1 := by
  unfold improvedConstant
  have h8 : (8 : ℝ) < Real.sqrt 73 := by
    have : Real.sqrt 64 < Real.sqrt 73 := by
      apply Real.sqrt_lt_sqrt <;> norm_num
    simpa [show (64 : ℝ) = 8 ^ 2 by norm_num, Real.sqrt_sq] using this

noncomputable def smallerRoot : ℝ := (19 - Real.sqrt 73) / 18

noncomputable def largerRoot : ℝ := (19 + Real.sqrt 73) / 18

    rcases mul_eq_zero.1 h' with h1 | h1

  linarith

      simpa [show (49 : ℝ) = 7 ^ 2 by norm_num, Real.sqrt_sq] using this

root is exactly `(19 − √73)/18`. Why now? The two-sided window

**Conjecture.** If `G` admits an efficient (perfect) dominating set, then
`γ(G □ H) = γ(G) · γ(H)` for every `H`; i.e., Vizing's inequality is tight precisely in the
efficiently-dominated regime.

The key insight is that a perfect dominating set partitions the vertex set into disjoint closed
neighbourhoods, so the product decomposes into `γ(G)` independent copies whose domination numbers
